# Exact package set of the conda env `franka_il` that trained act_cubes_c100 (Python 3.11, CUDA 12.8 wheels),
# restricted to what LeRobot ACT training / eval / dataset conversion / the ZMQ policy server import:
# the dependency closure of lerobot 0.4.1 + diffusers + pyzmq + rerun-sdk + tyro, versions from
# `conda run -n franka_il pip freeze` on 2026-10-16 (full freeze: pip-freeze-franka_il-2026-10-16.txt).
#
# Install WITHOUT dependency resolution (the env deliberately violates some declared ranges that are harmless:
# numpy 1.26 under rerun-sdk's numpy>=2, wandb 0.28 above lerobot's <0.22; torchcodec, pynput, cmake and
# hf-transfer are not installed, lerobot falls back to pyav for video decoding):
#   pip install --no-deps -r requirements-franka_il.txt --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu128
# then lerobot itself (setup_env.sh does both):
#   lerobot @ git+https://github.com/huggingface/lerobot.git@a5b29d43 (+ optional patches/0001-*.patch)
